name: FLA_LEASE_PARTIES_HIST
description: FLA_LEASE_PARTIES_HIST contains the history of FLA_LEASE_PARTIES.

columns.name: LEASE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier is the sequence maintained to identify the row uniquely.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease details identifier which is referenced from FLA_LEASE_DETAILS_HIST table.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier that references the po_vendors table

columns.name: PARTY_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role identified to be played in the lease.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease data was created.

columns.name: FINAL_LEASE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Final lease party record identifier. This identifies the final record from the main table for this record.

columns.name: CHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of change to the record, whether INSERT or UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: CHANGED_IN_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number in which there was a change, either an Addition or Update or Delete.
